vibe.evidence: The layout is split into four distinct image blocks, with a large hero image on the left and smaller images on the right and bottom. The typography is clean and sans-serif, with a subtle hierarchy. The color palette is warm and earthy, with a focus on natural textures. The overall feel is sophisticated and luxurious.
